strings.checkout.steps:
1. In your browser, go to the address below (Studio can't open it for you).
2. Buy it there. Roblox handles the payment; Team Chat never sees your payment details.
3. Come back and press I bought it. It shows up once Roblox confirms the purchase.

strings.about.intro: Chat with your Team Create collaborators without leaving Studio: messages, DMs, polls, files and commands.
strings.about.disclaimer1: Team Chat is a community-made plugin. It is not made, endorsed, sponsored or affiliated with Roblox Corporation in any way, and Roblox is not responsible for it, its content or anything that happens through it.
strings.about.disclaimer2: Roblox, Robux, the Roblox logo and the verified badge are trademarks of Roblox Corporation. The verified badge only shows for accounts Roblox has verified.
strings.about.terms1: • The plugin is provided "as is", without any warranty. You use it at your own risk; keep backups of your places.
strings.about.terms2: • The developer isn't liable for lost work, lost messages or any other damage from using the plugin, as far as the law allows.
strings.about.terms3: • Follow the Roblox Terms of Use and Community Standards in the chat. Don't share passwords or personal information.
strings.about.terms4: • Badges are cosmetic. Team Chat Premium also unlocks the Midnight and Gold themes, longer messages and bigger polls. Bought badges are Roblox game passes: you buy them on Roblox.com, Roblox handles the payment, and Roblox's terms apply to the purchase.
strings.about.terms5: • These terms can change with plugin updates; What's New lists the changes.
strings.about.data1: Messages, DMs and polls are stored in this place (ServerStorage), so anyone who can edit the place can read them. Your settings are stored in Studio on your computer.
strings.about.data2: When you sign in with Roblox, this place's chat is also stored on the Team Chat backend, end-to-end encrypted: the backend can't read your messages, only who wrote them and when. Without signing in, nothing of yours is sent there. Avatars, names and badges come from Roblox. See PRIVACY.md.

strings.dev.docs.studioSteps: Studio bot: make one under New bot. Its script opens: give it commands like this one, then click Reload. It runs in your Studio while you're in the place.
strings.dev.docs.webSteps: Web bot: make one under New bot with your server's URL, put its token in your server's settings, answer the ping with your commands, and click Sync commands. Team Chat sends every command and button click to your URL.
strings.dev.docs.copyHint: Click into the code and press Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C to copy it.
strings.dev.docs.security: Check the X-TeamChat-Token header on every request. Everyone who can edit the place can see the token, so use it for this bot only and make a new one when someone leaves.
